events.title: Remote Control is in Too Many Games!
events.summary: Hello Handlers,We're excited to share that Remote Control is taking part in the Too Many Games showcase!If this is your first time coming across Remote Control, then now is a great time to hop into the demo. In Remote Control, you type commands to remote proxies who will follow your instructions and explore the strange corridors of the Pelican. Every wishlist helps us enormously, and you can join the Discord for more updates!-- Sam & Vicki

events.title: Introducing Remote Control - your new favourite sci-fi survival horror
events.summary: Welcome new Proxy Handlers! We’re so excited to be revealing Remote Control, our new game about controlling human proxies on The Pelican, an abandoned, derelict spaceship floating through space, to uncover what happened to the crew. You can check out our trailer below to get a sense of what fun guys you might be meeting on your playthrough. Control a crew of disposable Human ProxiesThese proxies will hallucinate based on their likes/dislikes and will (mostly) follow your commands to the letter.
